checks.name: Transaction tests run on HTTP with real writable IndexedDB
Real database initially stores phase-bearing schema 20 and binary data
Abort occurs after a successful real IDB request, not an application mock
Abort rolls back deletion, song update and binary overwrite together
Abort cannot promote snapshots or emit a success notification
Retry commits write and deletion with native completion
Conflicting deletion refuses the whole native request before mutation
Studio abort leaves source, edit, recovery and dirty state retryable
Native Studio retry removes the old recovery and preserves source charts
Reload retains the mixed commit, binary bytes and schema 20 phase
No unhandled exception during native abort/retry flow

scope: Real HTTP, IndexedDB, IDBTransaction.abort after a successful IDBRequest, mixed deletion rollback, Studio retry and page reload. Does not simulate OS crash, disk corruption or browser eviction.
